expected_structural_delta: 0 owners/services/stores/dependencies; 1 explicit status selector; 1 separate current-only projection; three production surfaces plus regression tests.
minimum_design: Extend the existing native status/controller with one selected current-only metadata read, protected receipt and current identity validation, and no lifecycle effects.
outcome: An explicitly selected existing native runner can yield bounded current-only public identity/image/limits/memory-file metadata even when original registration history is unavailable, without any lifecycle/receipt/config/credential effect.

reuse_decisions.name: Native CLI/controller ownership
reuse_decisions.rationale: Add one opt-in current-only read under the same root/fleet/config admission; preserve all lifecycle writers.

reuse_decisions.name: Original registration provenance
reuse_decisions.rationale: Keep existing unknown/original-unavailable semantics; never backfill history.

reuse_decisions.name: Native local metadata primitives
reuse_decisions.rationale: Use closed Docker fields and fixed kernel/public identity files; avoid environment and container execution.
